signals.source: github issue #2249 (dispatcher Tier-1d review, segment reality-server, 2026-07-11)
evidence: backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/sso.rs:923-924 — `extract_roles_from_scope(...).or_else(|| request.roles.clone())`. request.roles is a client-supplied field of ExchangeTokenRequest (sso.rs:849-855) documented as 'Optional: specific PM roles to include (for role filtering)' — but the .or_else clause turns it into a role source when scope carries no recognizable roles. A holder of any active-but-role-less PM token can self-elevate to AGENT / PROPERTY_OWNER / VERIFIED_USER by sending roles: ['agent'] in the exchange body → portal privilege escalation.
Fix: intersect scope-derived + client-supplied roles (narrow-only), never fall back.

evidence: mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/api/HttpClientProvider.kt:37 — shared HttpClient installs ContentNegotiation + Logging but no HttpTimeout plugin, so requests have no app-level request/connect/socket timeout and a stalled connection leaves every repository suspend call (and its UI spinner) hanging until the composition scope is cancelled.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/util/NetworkError.kt:29 — isNetworkError() matches on 'HttpRequestTimeoutException', which only the un-installed HttpTimeout plugin can throw, so the intended timeout->friendly-error path is unreachable.
